sources.snippet: Once converted to RKNN, parts of the model can run on the NPU, improving speed. Despite these limits, models like Qwen3 run well on the RK3588 because the NPU efficiently accelerates the heavy math, and the vision encoder can be optimised. This makes advanced multimodal AI feasible on small, power-efficient devices.
